messages.subject: Child Task 147201451 failed
parts:
Hi!

I am trying to deploy my Shiny App (shinyapps::deployApp()) and keep getting this error:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 147201451 failed: Error parsing manifest: Manifest file data/~$zipdata.xlsx checksum mismatch

My app works fine on my local computer. Do you have any idea why I am getting this error message?

Thanks,
Sarah

messages.author: 33fe3608622d7c76
messages.subject: Re: Child Task 147201451 failed
parts: I think the problem was related to the fact that my .xlsx file was still open. Once I closed it, it deployed successfully.
